notes: This contract records the bounded embedded support-switch service state. Per-federate setters remain independent, static federation-wide getters retain creation-time values, and automatic-resign enum validation uses the official 2025 values. Recipient-gated sent-region callback behavior is traced separately in convey-region-designator-callback-requirements-contract.json. The private embedded Connection Lost path now executes configured DELETE_OBJECTS, UNCONDITIONALLY_DIVEST_ATTRIBUTES, DELETE_OBJECTS_THEN_DIVEST, CANCEL_PENDING_OWNERSHIP_ACQUISITIONS, and CANCEL_THEN_DELETE_THEN_DIVEST directives through ordinary forced-resignation cleanup. The exact MOM report-service interaction is mutually excluded from enabled Service Reporting for both ordinary and regional subscriptions. The joined-federate HLAsetSwitches leaf accepts a non-empty subset of its nine predefined values, promotes compatible extension subclasses, and ignores extension parameters; its report-service interlock is surfaced through the bounded public Send Interaction error path rather than a normal MOM failure report. This is not emitted service reports, report-file output, generic MOM handling, or conformance evidence. The bounded NO_ACTION forced-resign policy, real transport faults, emitted service reports, and relaxed DDM/delayed subscription behavior remain open.
